text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- French Defence Minister Charles Millon said after meeting President ben Ali on Monday that Tunisia and France have a great role to establish peace and security in the Mediterranean.
- Tunisia and Malta held talks on boosting bilateral trade exchanges.
- Hungarian speaker of parliament Zoltan Gal expected on Wednesday in Tunis.
- Hotels are mushrooming at the seaside resort of Gammarth, northern Tunis.
- Tunisia's production of milk covers 89 percent of its needs.
- Tunis Air plans 57 shuttle flights for the haj pilgrimage to Saudi from March 28 to April 24.
- Tunisia to import 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes of potatoes during the next few days.
- Tunisian-French joint military commission on Monday started meetings in Tunis to boost partnership and cooperation between the two countries.
